description: This file defines the 'ProspectsViewDetail' class which extends 'ViewDetail'. It is part of the SuiteCRM project and renders the detailed view of prospects, including retrieving related lead data if available. The class customizes the display method to assign lead information to the view if the lead ID exists.

classes.name: ProspectsViewDetail
classes.description: A view class extending 'ViewDetail' to show detailed prospect information, with custom logic to load associated lead data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that calls the parent constructor.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Overrides the parent 'display' method to fetch and assign lead information if 'lead_id' is present in the bean object.
